one_line: Mahayana Buddhist monk of Nalanda and author of the Bodhicaryāvatāra.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, slim and lightly built, with the wiry strength of a long-time ascetic
appearance.face: oval face with calm, medium-brown Magadha complexion, straight nose, soft but intense dark eyes, fine brows, a small neatly trimmed moustache and goatee, default expression thoughtful and serene with a hint of inward focus
appearance.hair: short, evenly tonsured black hair close to the scalp, with a simple saffron cloth band tied around the head like a narrow headband, no ornaments
appearance.costume: era-accurate Buddhist monk’s triple robe: an inner pale ochre cotton tunic with long sleeves and a round neck, over which a maroon cotton saṃghāti (outer robe) is wrapped over the left shoulder and around the body leaving the right shoulder modestly covered by a saffron uttarāsanga stole; the robes are simple, slightly worn, with subtle hand-stitched borders, draping to the ankles and paired with plain brown leather sandals; under the robe the lower body is covered by a soft saffron antaravāsaka skirt-like garment, with a fabric belt knot visible beneath the outer folds.
appearance.signature: A worn but carefully kept palm-leaf manuscript bundle of the Bodhicaryāvatāra, bound with a dark cord and held respectfully in his left hand, with a simple wooden rosary (mālā) looped around his wrist.

ref_desc: Śāntideva is a slim early-30s monk with medium-brown oval face, short tonsured black hair and saffron headband, wearing maroon and saffron Nalanda-style triple robes to the ankles with brown sandals, carrying a palm-leaf Bodhicaryāvatāra manuscript and wooden rosary in a maroon-saffron-brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Śāntideva: a slim early-30s Nalanda monk with a medium-brown oval face, straight nose, thoughtful dark eyes, fine brows, and a small neat moustache and goatee, expression calm and inwardly focused. His hair is short and tonsured black, close to the scalp, with a simple saffron cloth band tied as a narrow headband. He wears historically accurate late 7th–early 8th century Buddhist monastic robes: an inner pale ochre long-sleeved cotton tunic and a saffron antaravāsaka lower garment completely covering his legs, all wrapped in a maroon cotton saṃghāti outer robe that drapes over the left shoulder and around the body, while a saffron uttarāsanga stole keeps the right shoulder modestly covered; the robes are plain, slightly worn, with subtle stitched borders, and fall to his ankles above plain brown leather sandals. In his left hand he respectfully holds a worn palm-leaf manuscript bundle bound with a dark cord, representing the Bodhicaryāvatāra, and a simple wooden rosary looped around his wrist. Show him from multiple angles to clarify the maroon and saffron drapery and the way the robes layer over his body, keeping everything fully clothed and modest, with a clear maroon-saffron-pale ochre-brown-dark wood colour palette.
